findings: New read-only LR prefix verifier accepts exactly1 through9 ordered completed slots and independent expected frozen requests. Full LR/rank boundaries and partial LR prefixes reuse identical per-member and stage-local integrity checks. Every prefix member, including provisional winners, requires full evidence. Checkpoint pairs feed future storage accounting; this API grants no storage or dispatch authorization.

All prefix lengths preserve all files. Even nine reviewed LR screens produce neither a selection nor a cleanup manifest; persisted final stage selection and its full boundary review remain separate prerequisites.

Initial tests rejected missing resource evidence with KeyError in two cases; explicit producer input validation now raises ValueError. Both initial failures and logs are retained. Final289 tests pass, including original full LR/rank audit, pilot audit and storage regressions.
limitations: All new prefixes are synthetic metadata and tiny byte checkpoint fixtures. No actual model loading, optimizer continuation, EMA recurrence, MPS execution, or scientific quality result is established.

Caller must still hold worker locks and an outer guard, bind the full frozen campaign and pilot history, recheck full remaining-panel storage and provide process handoff. Later selection-aware startup, dispatch, LR/rank cleanup and inference orchestration remain incomplete.

Actual nine rank-policy numerical/input and measured-pilot prerequisites remain unresolved. The failed combined CPU numerical fixture and closed controllers were not rerun; all research checkpoints and the closed test holdout remain untouched. The27-trajectory campaign remains unfrozen.
